acceptance_condition: Returns at least two design constraints and at least one evaluation-replication requirement, each explicitly labeled as 'design inference'. The design constraints identify substrate behaviors needed to retain Du et al.'s gains (e.g., multiple competing answers, cross-agent critique, iterative refinement, consensus convergence). The evaluation-replication requirement specifies the condition that replicates Du et al.'s setup (e.g., 3 agents, 2 rounds, same tasks, consensus prompt) and is falsifiable.
rationale: This child isolates the design-inference portion of the node objective. It is analytically independent from the evidence-extraction child because it derives conclusions from the same source file but does not need the extracted findings pre-formatted; it can independently read the source and produce its inferences. The parent will combine the extracted evidence with these inferences.
text: From the Du et al. source text, derive and return, each explicitly labeled as design inference: (b1) which debate behaviors a shared question/answer substrate must capture to retain the reported gains, and (b2) what an evaluation condition replicating the paper's setup would require. This includes at least two design constraints and at least one evaluation-replication requirement.
